info.title: Legal market crosswalks: practice areas, federal case codes, states, federal districts and counties: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Legal market crosswalks: practice areas, federal case codes, states, federal districts and counties: The shared keys that join every Probative dataset. One record per practice area (our taxonomy of consumer and business practice areas, each linked to the FOLIO Area of Law class it matches, the federal nature-of-suit codes of its cases, the site's practice pages and the datasets that measure its demand, supply, rules and money), per federal nature-of-suit code, per state and territory (FIPS and postal codes, Census region and division, federal circuit and districts), per federal judicial district (our district key, the Federal Judicial Center code and the court's CM/ECF id) and per county (FIPS code, the federal district and statutory division it belongs to under 28 U.S.C. chapter 5, its metro or micro area and its 2025 population). Every county's district is read from the statute and checked against the counties U.S. Courts lists under each district in its bankruptcy Table F-5A.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
